title: Invasion dynamics with vanishing fitness for a quasi-critical birth-death process
summary: We study the invasion dynamics of populations exhibiting positive density-dependent effects. We start with a single individual and consider a single-type birth and death process. The initial individual growth rate vanishes but it increases with the population density, proportionally to the number of individuals divided by a scaling parameter $K$. Before reaching the macroscopic scale~$K$, the population process is almost critical.
